title: ModelRegistry
description: Schema for a single model registry entry. The registry is owned by Navigator (not Assessor). Assessor references model_id values from this registry when building Assay records.

provider.description: Provider name as a lowercase slug (e.g. 'anthropic', 'openai', 'google', 'meta').

model_id.description: Canonical model identifier as used by the provider API (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'gpt-4o-2024-11-20').

model_family.description: Model family grouping for cohort analysis (e.g. 'claude-sonnet', 'gpt-4o'). Nullable.

provider_tier.description: Capability tier. frontier = most capable, capable = strong general-purpose, economy = fast/cheap, local = locally-hosted.

context_window.description: Maximum context window size in tokens.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens per response. Nullable if not publicly documented.

pricing_input_per_1m_tokens.description: Input pricing in USD per 1M tokens. Nullable if pricing is unavailable or variable.

pricing_output_per_1m_tokens.description: Output pricing in USD per 1M tokens. Nullable if pricing is unavailable or variable.

availability_regions.description: List of availability region codes (e.g. ['us', 'eu', 'ap']). Empty array = globally available.

deprecated_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this model was deprecated or end-of-life. Null if still active.

notes.description: Free-text notes about this model (e.g. 'Optimized for extended thinking', 'Vision support added 2025-01').
